# requirements.lock
# Pinned dependency lock file for trustdemo==0.1.0.
#
# INTENTIONALLY EMPTY.
#
# Per DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.txt, trustdemo declares no runtime dependencies:
# - pyproject.toml contains no `dependencies` in the [project] section.
# - Built metadata (trustdemo-0.1.0.dist-info/METADATA) has zero
#   `Requires-Dist` entries.
# - A fresh `pip install . --target <empty-dir>` pulled in no packages
#   besides trustdemo itself.
#
# There are therefore no direct or transitive dependency versions to pin.
# The `setuptools>=61.0` entry in [build-system] is a build-time requirement
# handled by build isolation and is intentionally not locked here.
